data.narrative:
Callosum is an AI & Software company founded by Danyal Akarca and Jascha Achterberg at an undisclosed stage. The broader AI & Software sector includes 12 comparable private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR). The most proximate private peers identified are Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition, though stage alignment and valuation tier proximity remain unclear from available data.

Peer-median triangulation was not applicable to this analysis. The AI & Software sector contains sufficient breadth—12 total private comparables—but insufficient depth within narrow filters. No same-stage peers, adjacent-stage peers, or similar-tier peers meeting the minimum threshold of three datapoints could be identified. A median derived from the full sector would risk material misrepresentation given wide stage and scale heterogeneity typical of AI/Software.

Without applicable quantitative triangulation methods, this analysis cannot produce a defensible valuation range. Completion of a credible assessment requires either: (1) disclosure of Callosum's stage and prior funding history to enable tighter peer filtering, or (2) expansion of comparable data within narrower valuation tiers. The presence of Palantir as a public comp provides a sector-level reference point but does not substitute for stage-appropriate private peer analysis. Further data collection is necessary before advancing a triangulated valuation view.
